description:
## Summary

- Adds ADR-049 proposing a four-layer policy-based authorization architecture (authentication, resource resolution, policy evaluation, enforcement) to replace the current procedural if-then-else chains scattered across five files and four middleware layers.
- Introduces `SecurityResource` trait and `ResourceDescriptor` to unify the five duplicated visibility-check blocks (servers, tools, resources, prompts, gateways) into a single resource-type-agnostic policy path.
- Includes an implementation-agnostic open source survey and weighted suitability scoring of Cedar, OPA/Regorus, and Casbin, with Cedar recommended as the policy engine.
- Implements [ADR-045](docs/docs/architecture/adr/045-auth-remains-in-core.md) (auth remains in core).

## Test plan

- [ ] Review ADR content for accuracy against current codebase
- [ ] Validate that the `SecurityResource` trait maps cleanly to existing ORM model fields
- [ ] Confirm policy rules preserve all existing security invariants
- [ ] Verify open source version inventory is current
